method: Global alignment, bust pre-scale, then ARAP with contact vertices targeted to body surface plus layer offset. Cups bridge the cleavage (push-out only); the lower band edge near the centre rests on the ribs. Pauldron and gem plate placed rigidly outside the skin; the ring hinges back from the plate onto the band.

weights.method: Inverse-distance transfer from skin; cups take smoothed skin weights, the jewel Spine1 0.9/Spine2 0.1 and the pauldron one shoulder bone (both rigid); straps and band smoothed across the welded surface.

rigging.method: Inverse-distance transfer from skin; cups take smoothed skin weights, the jewel Spine1 0.9/Spine2 0.1 and the pauldron one shoulder bone (both rigid); straps and band smoothed across the welded surface.
